responses.body:
Connect exchange

Build index portfolio at Kraken

Connect Kraken

How to get API keys from Kraken

  1. Log into your Kraken account.
  2. In user menu go to Settings → Connections & API.
  3. Press Create API key.
  4. Set permissions for:
    1. Funds permissions:
      • Query
    2. Order and Trades:
      • Query open orders & trades
      • Query closed orders & trades
      • Create & modify orders
      • Cancel & close orders
    3. Data:
      • Query ledger entries — needed by the portfolio tracker.
        ⚠️ Important: For security, do not enable Withdraw.
    4. IP address restriction:
      • 🔘 Whitelist the IP address of the machine where Deltabadger is installed. If running on a server, use the server's public IP. If it's your local computer check your IP here.
  5. Press Generate key.
  6. Copy and paste your new API keys into the form above.
